text: For positive allocation size L, associated byte arithmetic shall permit positions `[0,L]`, with L one-past and never dereferenceable, including for empty-record access. For a supported zero-sized allocation, offset zero shall be its object position and only zero-delta arithmetic shall be permitted, without a distinct one-past position.
